prompt:
You are a procurement analyst writing a short decision memo for a garment exporter's manager.

STRICT RULES (an automatic checker enforces them; violating output is discarded):
1. Do NOT write any digit or any number word (two, five, hundred, percent, half, double ...) in your text.
2. Every number must be written as a placeholder with a key from the FACTS list, e.g. {{plan.p_meet}}.
   Use only keys from the list. The placeholder is replaced by the exact value shown, so write units
   that the value lacks yourself (e.g. "{{plan.pieces}} pieces"; percentages and BDT already carry theirs).
   Always wrap the key in double braces: write {{line.F0123.fail_share}}, never line.F0123.fail_share.
3. Refer to a factory only as {{fac:F0123}}, using IDs that appear in the FACTS keys.
4. Do not compute or compare numbers yourself (no "higher by", no sums). Cite facts and explain them.
5. A human approves every decision. Nothing is sent to any factory automatically; say so where relevant.
6. All performance data in this prototype is synthetic; do not present it as real-world evidence.

CONTEXT: Recommend a subcontracting plan for the order. Compare it with the naive plan (declared capacity + lowest price), the naive plan with the same buffer, and the buffer the naive plan would need to match ours. Name the main risks (concentration, factories that drive failures).

FACTS (key = value: meaning):
order.total_qty = 150,000: buyer order quantity
order.own_capacity = 100,000: exporter's own capacity
order.subcontract_qty = 50,000: quantity to subcontract (Q)
order.deadline = 31 Jan 2027: fixed delivery deadline
funnel.compliant = 442: T-shirt factories that are RSC-covered or hold a valid BSCI audit
funnel.candidates = 221: of those, with spare capacity that fits the deadline
plan.target_p = 90%: target probability of on-time delivery within tolerance
plan.slack_days = 4 days: planned slack before the latest finish date
plan.tolerance = 2%: accepted shortfall: success means good pieces of at least (1 - this) of Q
plan.min_good = 49,000: good pieces (after QC) needed by the deadline for success
plan.p_meet = 87.5%: recommended plan: probability that the subcontracted quantity (order.subcontract_qty) arrives on time as good pieces, within the delivery tolerance
plan.buffer_pct = 25%: recommended plan: over-allocation buffer
plan.pieces = 62,500: recommended plan: pieces allocated
plan.buffer_pieces = 12,500: recommended plan: buffer pieces above Q
plan.cost_total = 8,237,537 BDT: recommended plan: total cost
plan.buffer_cost = 1,627,507 BDT: recommended plan: price of the buffer
plan.n_factories = 5: recommended plan: number of factories
plan.target_met = no: does the plan reach the target
base.p_meet = 1.2%: naive plan (declared capacity + lowest price): probability that the subcontracted quantity arrives on time as good pieces, within the delivery tolerance
base.cost_total = 6,314,544 BDT: naive plan: total cost
basebuf.p_meet = 77.8%: naive plan with the same buffer: probability that the subcontracted quantity arrives on time as good pieces, within the delivery tolerance
basebuf.cost_total = 7,921,756 BDT: naive plan with the same buffer: total cost
match.buffer_pct = 32.5%: buffer the naive plan needs to match our probability (search allowed beyond our ceiling)
match.cost_total = 8,488,014 BDT: naive plan at that buffer: total cost
match.extra_cost = +250,477 BDT: extra cost of the naive plan to match ours
